proof_scope: Quasi-continuous fixed weights plus common capacity modulus handle moving bounded weights and null sharp levels. Uniform second moments give fixed-measure L1 convergence without compact support. A quadratic maximum barrier and compact-difference current identity give finite-mass strict perturbations; comparison passes at levels null for both finite measures, proves a pointwise bound for the canonical representative, zero boundary trace and the bounded limiting equation. Finite prescribed mass permits cancellation in strict comparison and proves the pointwise envelope and uniqueness. All subsequential limits agree, giving full canonical-sequence convergence. n>=1 and zero measure retained. No uniform bound for approximants or interior continuity assumed.
